name: Pensacola Para Con
blurb: A Pensacola convention for sci-fi, anime, horror and paranormal fans, founded in 2010 as the first female African-American-owned comic con in the US.
notes: Also known as 'Pensacola Comic Convention' (the id and name Wikipedia uses) — founded Fall 2010 by psychic medium Ericka Boussarhane, billed as the first female African-American-owned comic convention in the US. The given URL (pensacolacomiccon.com) redirects to the convention's current site, now branded 'Pensacola Para Con' (Sci-Fi, Anime, Paranormal, Horror, Metaphysical and Pop Culture). The homepage's newest content is still the September 23-24, 2023 edition (guests were paranormal-TV ghost hunters Chris Smith and Mike Goncalves of 'Ghost Asylum'/'Haunted Towns'); no 2024, 2025 or 2026 edition is announced anywhere on the site, and a WebSearch for recent Para Con dates returned only results for the unrelated, much larger Pensacon. Marked inactive/on hiatus since the last known 2023 run; no editions listed since nothing has been announced since.
